<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="Invitation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GameList" name="List of games"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Plan LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive list of games" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Plan date and games in parallel" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAvailability" name="Check how many friends are available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateAccepted" name="Are at least 8 people available?" default="Flow_DateNotAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointAnotherDate" name="Appoint another date"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether all requested games are available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMissing" name="Are any games missing?" default="Flow_GamesAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Continue after checking games" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date and games ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindBeerRequirement" name="Find out how much beer friends require"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBeer" name="Check whether enough beer is available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerEnough" name="Is there enough beer?" default="Flow_BeerInsufficient"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue with enough beer" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Send" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Receive" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Split" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Date" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Appoint_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_CheckAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_DateAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateAccepted" name="At least 8 available" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAccepted" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">availableCount >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNotAccepted" name="Fewer than 8 available" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAccepted" targetRef="Task_AppointAnotherDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnotherDate_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="Task_AppointAnotherDate" targetRef="Task_CheckAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Games" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGames_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing" name="Some games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMissing" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">someGamesMissing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable" name="No games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMissing" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Download_GamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_BeerRequirement" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_FindBeerRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerRequirement_Check" sourceRef="Task_FindBeerRequirement" targetRef="Task_CheckBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckBeer_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">beerAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerInsufficient" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enjoy_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Host" name="LAN party planner" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="List of games" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
